reason: The native 32-replication run reports NREP=32 and aggregate bins but its event log exposes only one replication. A separately sealed matrix of one-replication runs is required to observe all mission timelines directly.
exact_seed_delta: From the frozen aggregate A08 input, set Control.NREPS 32 to 1, Control.RSEED to the seed number as a string, and ProblemDescription.PDESC to a seed-specific label. Every other row and table stays unchanged.
execution: One session-0 SSH batch holds the host-wide Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue mutex for all 32 seed runs and checks GUI PID 13340 before and after each native step.

Each seed has a unique immutable versioned subdirectory with copied input, import/export/calc/jsonreport logs and files, exact 13-source-table roundtrip, per-step record, raw SHA-256 seals and an outer source-hash-before/after closure.
Any failed native command, missing output, changed source, altered GUI, missing seed, or roundtrip mismatch fails the batch; no partial matrix is published as accepted.
predeclared_acceptance: All 32 seeds convert with zero errors and classified warnings; each one-replication report has NREP=1 and 72 aligned half-hour bins.

Each seed logs exactly three distinct fixed-template mission starts in [8,20), with matching success/completion two hours later, no cancellation, failure, repair or stock demand, and three aircraft ready at report end.

The 32 ordered start-time triples must not all be identical; preserve all 96 raw timestamps and their seed identities. Report observed sample mean, sample variance and nominal 95 percent Student-t half-width, targeting at most one hour; this is a precision description, not proof of uniformity or stream independence.

Compare the one-replication seed-1 timeline with the earlier 32-replication run's logged timeline only as an observed same-seed check. Do not assume equal random streams across different NREPS controls or external engines.

Reconcile each seed's two-hour missions and six aircraft operation-hours with its own report; compare only compatible aggregate quantities with the 32-replication report, because the batch uses distinct explicit RSEED values.
A separate read-only reviewer replays the manifest, generated source hashes, each raw closure, all event/report ledgers and the statistics without importing author validation.
limits: The 32 seeds form a fixed convenience matrix, not a random sample of seed values. Confidence half-width is a nominal descriptive interval conditional on native outputs; it cannot establish true RNG distribution or independence.
Random mission quantity, equal spacing, zero period, invalid combinations, GUI visual behavior and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
